ROW.COLUMN: (FR/AC) Anomalies in ATM, Bank Card: Excessive Withdrawals at Multiple Locations

Automated Teller Machines (ATMs) are anonymous channels that facilitate the avoidance of bank personnel. An increase in the number of ATM withdrawals and the use of multiple ATM locations may indicate a fraudster's use of skimmed data and counterfeit ATM or bankcards.

with All_Trxn as
(SELECT DISTINCT a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.ACCT_SEQ_ID, a.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB, ct.DATA_DUMP_DT, ct.TRXN_EXCTN_DT, sm1.Atm_Trxn_Out_Day_Ct, sm1.Atm_Trxn_Out_Am
FROM @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN ct INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on ct.ACCT_INTRL_ID = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID /*months prior to the current month*/ LEFT OUTER JOIN (select sm.ACCT_INTRL_ID, sum(sm.ATM_TRXN_OUT_DAY_CT) as Atm_Trxn_Out_Day_Ct, sum(sm.ATM_TRXN_OUT_AM) as Atm_Trxn_Out_Am from @BUSINESS@.ACCT_SMRY_MNTH sm where sm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT < (select add_months(f_trunc_date(k.CLNDR_DT, 'MM'), 0) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and sm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT >= (select add_months(f_trunc_date(k.CLNDR_DT, 'MM'),-@Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') group by sm.ACCT_INTRL_ID) sm1 on a.ACCT_INTRL_ID = sm1.ACCT_INTRL_ID WHERE ct.DATA_DUMP_DT = (select b.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL b where b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) -- Include ATM Withdrawal/Outgoing/Debit Transactions Only AND ct.DBT_CDT_CD='D' AND ct.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD = 'ATM' -- Include Customer Retail Accounts Only AND a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CR' -- Exclude Exempted Accounts AND a.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-Of-Account Transactions AND ct.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- ---------- AND (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl='Y' or a.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) AND a.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst) AND (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' or ct.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) )
SELECT v.ACCT_INTRL_ID , v.ACCT_SEQ_ID , v.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB , v.Actvty_Risk_Lvl , v.Tot_Trans_Amt , v.Tot_Trans_Ct , v.TRXN_EXCTN_DT -- Two Days Average ATM WD Amount , v.Avg_2Days_Amt -- Historical Average ATM WD Amount , v.Avg_Hist_Amt -- Highlights , case when v.Tot_Trans_Amt=0 then 0 else v.Hr_Trans_Amt/v.Tot_Trans_Amt*100 end as Hr_Prctg , case when v.Tot_Trans_Amt=0 then 0 else v.Lrf_Trans_Amt/v.Tot_Trans_Amt*100 end as Lrf_Prctg -- --------------------------------------------------------------- , v.Overall_Risk , (((v.Avg_2Days_Amt - v.Avg_Hist_Amt)/v.Avg_Hist_Amt) * 100) as Pct_Daily_Amt_Incr
FROM
( SELECT tr.ACCT_INTRL_ID, tr.ACCT_SEQ_ID, tr.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB, case when max(tr.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB) >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and max(ct1.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) >= @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'HR' when max(tr.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB) < @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and max(ct1.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) < @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'RR' else 'MR' end Overall_Risk, max(ct1.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) as Actvty_Risk_Lvl, tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT, count(distinct ct1.TRXN_EXCTN_DT) as Days_Ct, sum(ct1.TRXN_BASE_AM) as Tot_Trans_Amt, count(distinct ct1.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID) as Tot_Trans_Ct, -- Two Days Average ATM WD Amount case when count(distinct ct1.TRXN_EXCTN_DT) = 0 then 0 else sum(ct1.TRXN_BASE_AM)/count(distinct ct1.TRXN_EXCTN_DT) end as Avg_2Days_Amt, -- Historical Average ATM WD Amount case when (coalesce(tr.Atm_Trxn_Out_Day_Ct,0) + coalesce(asm.Atm_Trxn_Out_Day_Ct,0)) = 0 then 0 else (coalesce(tr.Atm_Trxn_Out_Am,0) + coalesce(asm.Atm_Trxn_Out_Am,0))/(coalesce(tr.Atm_Trxn_Out_Day_Ct,0) + coalesce(asm.Atm_Trxn_Out_Day_Ct,0)) end as Avg_Hist_Amt, -- Highlights sum(CASE WHEN (ct1.TRXN_BASE_AM - trunc(ct1.TRXN_BASE_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 or ct1.TRXN_ACTVY_AM - trunc(ct1.TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0) THEN ct1.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END) Lrf_Trans_Amt, sum(CASE WHEN ct1.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl THEN ct1.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END) Hr_Trans_Amt
FROM All_Trxn tr INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN ct1 on tr.ACCT_INTRL_ID = ct1.ACCT_INTRL_ID and ct1.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT and ct1.TRXN_EXCTN_DT >= add_days(tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT, -1) /*the month to day prior to the previous day.*/ LEFT OUTER JOIN (select ct2.ACCT_INTRL_ID, tr2.TRXN_EXCTN_DT, count(distinct ct2.TRXN_EXCTN_DT) as Atm_Trxn_Out_Day_Ct, sum(ct2.TRXN_BASE_AM) as Atm_Trxn_Out_Am from All_Trxn tr2 inner join @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN ct2 on tr2.ACCT_INTRL_ID = ct2.ACCT_INTRL_ID where ct2.TRXN_EXCTN_DT < add_days(tr2.TRXN_EXCTN_DT, -1) and ct2.TRXN_EXCTN_DT >= (select k.clndr_dt from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.clndr_nm = 'SYSCAL' and k.mnth_bndry_cd = 'SD0') --BUG25096137 -- Include ATM Withdrawal/Outgoing/Debit Transactions Only AND ct2.DBT_CDT_CD='D' AND ct2.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD = 'ATM' -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-Of-Account Transactions AND ct2.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' AND (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' or ct2.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst))
group by ct2.ACCT_INTRL_ID, tr2.TRXN_EXCTN_DT ) asm on tr.ACCT_INTRL_ID = asm.ACCT_INTRL_ID and asm.TRXN_EXCTN_DT = tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT WHERE --BUG25096137 -- Include ATM Withdrawal/Outgoing/Debit Transactions Only ct1.DBT_CDT_CD='D' AND ct1.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD = 'ATM' -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-Of-Account Transactions AND ct1.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' AND (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' or ct1.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst))
GROUP BY tr.ACCT_INTRL_ID, tr.ACCT_SEQ_ID, tr.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB, tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT, asm.Atm_Trxn_Out_Day_Ct, tr.Atm_Trxn_Out_Day_Ct, tr.Atm_Trxn_Out_Am, asm.Atm_Trxn_Out_Am ) v
WHERE ( v.Overall_Risk = 'HR' and v.Avg_Hist_Amt > 0 and v.Avg_2Days_Amt >= @HR_Min_Daily_Average_ATM_WD_Amt and (((v.Avg_2Days_Amt - v.Avg_Hist_Amt)/v.Avg_Hist_Amt) * 100) >= @HR_Pct_Daily_ATM_WD_Amt_Increase ) OR ( v.Overall_Risk = 'MR' and v.Avg_Hist_Amt > 0 and v.Avg_2Days_Amt >= @MR_Min_Daily_Average_ATM_WD_Amt and (((v.Avg_2Days_Amt - v.Avg_Hist_Amt)/v.Avg_Hist_Amt) * 100) >= @MR_Pct_Daily_ATM_WD_Amt_Increase ) OR ( v.Overall_Risk = 'RR' and v.Avg_Hist_Amt > 0 and v.Avg_2Days_Amt >= @RR_Min_Daily_Average_ATM_WD_Amt and (((v.Avg_2Days_Amt - v.Avg_Hist_Amt)/v.Avg_Hist_Amt) * 100) >= @RR_Pct_Daily_ATM_WD_Amt_Increase )

SELECT DISTINCT ct1.ACCT_INTRL_ID, tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT, ct1.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID, ct1.TRXN_LOC_ID FROM All_Trxn tr LEFT OUTER JOIN @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN ct1 on tr.ACCT_INTRL_ID = ct1.ACCT_INTRL_ID and ct1.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT and ct1.TRXN_EXCTN_DT >= add_days(tr.TRXN_EXCTN_DT, -1) WHERE --BUG25096137 -- Include ATM Withdrawal/Outgoing/Debit Transactions Only ct1.DBT_CDT_CD='D' AND ct1.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD = 'ATM' -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-Of-Account Transactions AND ct1.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' AND (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' or ct1.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst))
